notes.title: New levels are coming, old levels are being adjusted!
notes.content:
I didn't expect it, auditors! The 'Wangwen Love Life Meaning' has been updated! The updated content is as follows:
Bug fixes
1. UI misalignment at partial resolution (thank you for the feedback from the sneering black demon)
optimize
1. Add performance display to the level selection interface (thank you for feedback from Arctic_Tundra)
2. Press the P key on the level selection interface to unlock all levels with just one click (without affecting achievement acquisition)
newly added
1. Add acceleration barrage and change barrage (thank you for the suggestion that Death must die)
Starting from the third level, some of the original bullet comments will be changed to acceleration bullet comments and line change bullet comments
3. Added 20. How to prove the level? The level is equipped with up and down/left and right dancing barrage, hoping to bring a new experience to the reviewer!
Not reproduced
1. Some auditors have reported that there is a problem of black screen freezing during ESC rollback in the checkpoint, but it was not successfully reproduced. Firstly, we apologize to the auditors who encountered the problem and hope that they can provide a reproduction operation. Thank you very much!
2. Some reviewers provided feedback that the game did not pause (including music) when it was in the background, but it also failed to reproduce QAQ
Finally, I hope everyone has fun! Thank you for playing 'Wangwen Love Lives Righteousness'! If you encounter any problems during the game, please feel free to join QQ group 460231906 and give feedback to the group leader Bai Qigugu!
